name: Glossary, Index & Demos
author: Brett
description: An encyclopedia of AmberX AXF and the demonstrations written from it. Glossary (A–Z definitions), Index (a categorized tree, like the back of a book) and Grid views of every plugin, feature, screen, control, setting, command, asset, asset type, CLI tool, build option, job type and core concept, built from what the repo registers (plugin manifests, help entries, framework assets, the feature tracker, the UI registry) so it stays complete with no hand-kept list; every entry shows what it is, what it does, where it appears, its API (REST, MCP, CLI), what it links to and what links to it. From any entry, Generate demonstration writes a narrated demo (demonstration@1) with zero tokens; the Demonstration Designer edits its steps, narration, highlights and actions, plays it against the live UI (voice-controlled, chainable into tours) and keeps every recorded clip as a tagged asset (clip@1); the Book Builder writes books of chapters (book@1) from dragged-in entries, demonstrations and clips, with a live sandbox preview, a whole-book preview, the walkthrough video and generated documentation up to interactive HTML + TypeScript (docs@1). Rebuilt after every build (build-hook@1); CI fails when something registered has no entry. Also over REST, the MCP tools glossary_index_* and `axf glossary-index …`. No model, no tokens.

items.title: Glossary size
items.description: How many entries the glossary has, per kind (plugins, features, screens, controls, settings, commands, assets, CLI tools…), when it was built and how many still lack a description of their own.

items.title: Search the glossary
items.description: Entries matching every word (term, summary, keywords, category), best first; optionally only some kinds (comma-separated: plugin, feature, screen, control, setting, command, asset, asset-type, cli, concept…).

items.title: One glossary entry
items.description: One entry by id (e.g. plugin:build-manager, concept:asset, control:console-web:ui-review:approve) with what it is, what it does, where it appears, its API, its links and what links to it.

items.title: Glossary change log
items.description: What each rebuild of the glossary added, changed and removed, newest first, with the build that caused it.
items.output: [{ at, reason, build, counts, added, changed, removed }]

items.title: Rebuild the glossary
items.description: Rebuild the glossary and index from the registries now (it also rebuilds by itself after every build). Writes only when something moved.

items.title: List demonstrations, books, clips and docs
items.description: Every demonstration, book, clip and documentation set (demonstration@1, book@1, clip@1, docs@1) kept by the console, with the facts of each: steps and seconds, chapters and minutes, media and source, depth and files.

q.description: only rows matching every word (name, description, entry, id) — the designer's Search

generated.description: only demonstrations generated from the glossary — the designer's Only generated switch

items.title: One demonstration, book, clip or docs asset
items.description: The whole asset@1 record of one demonstration, book, clip or documentation set by type and id (the framework's starters count too).

items.title: Save a demonstration, book, clip or docs asset
items.description: Validates an asset against its contract (demonstration@1, book@1, clip@1 or docs@1), normalises it, stores it in the plugin's data folder and rebuilds the glossary so it shows as an entry at once.

items.title: Delete a demonstration, book, clip or docs asset
items.description: Removes one stored asset (a framework starter can't be removed) and rebuilds the glossary.

items.title: New blank demonstration
items.description: Makes a blank demonstration with one placeholder step and saves it at once (the Demonstration Designer's Blank button); the id comes from the name and never overwrites an existing one.

items.title: Change a demonstration
items.description: One edit to a demonstration, saved at once — everything the Demonstration Designer's editor does: set (name, description, app, surface, speed, narrator, about), add-step, set-step (title, say, do, target, highlight, wait), move-step (dir -1/1 or to), remove-step, chain-add, chain-remove. Steps are numbered from 0.

items.title: Generate a demonstration from a glossary entry
items.description: Writes a narrated demonstration of any glossary entry from the entry's own words, where it appears, its API and its links: an intro step that moves the console there and highlights it, what it does, where, its API, what it contains, see also. Zero tokens. Saved as an asset unless save is false.

entry.description: the glossary entry id (plugin:build-manager, concept:asset, control:console-web:ui-review:approve)

build.description: the build that asked for it

items.title: A demonstration, book or clip as walkthrough@1
items.description: The playable walkthrough@1 (steps of say, do, target) of a demonstration, of a whole book (chapter intros plus every item's steps) or of a clip's transcript: what the player and Molly's guide play, and what the recorder films.

items.title: New book (the wizard)
items.description: Makes a book from the wizard's answers: title, what it is about, rough total minutes, minutes per chapter, number of chapters, style (quickstart, tutorial, tour, reference, deep-dive), the look to record in, narrator voice and speed, the documentation to generate (depth, format, how interactive) and the outputs (video, one clip per chapter). The chapters are created empty, ready for dragged-in entries.

items.title: Change a book
items.description: One change to a book: add-item (a glossary entry id or demonstration/<id>, clip/<id>, book/<id>#<chapter> into a chapter at an index), remove-item, move-item (between or within chapters), move-chapter, add-chapter, remove-chapter, rename-chapter, set-chapter (minutes, intro, collapsed), set-item (minutes, note), set-plan, set-docs or set-outputs; a name or description on the change renames the book.

items.title: The outline of every book
items.description: Every book (or one) as a tree for the Book Builder: chapters with their minutes and counts, items with their labels resolved through the glossary.

items.title: Record a book as a walkthrough video
items.description: Hands a book to the walkthrough recorder: its walkthrough@1 is written beside the book and the hired Walkthrough producer gets the amberx-walkthrough job with the chapters as its flow. dryRun shows the brief without launching.

items.title: Register a recorded clip
items.description: Registers a clip the recorder (or anything else) made as a clip@1 asset: validated, auto-tagged with a large keyword set from its source, the entries it shows, every step's actions and targets, every word of the narration, the app, the look and the voice, stored and indexed in the glossary.

asset.description: { id?, name?, description?, data: clip@1 data }

items.title: A clip from a filmed demonstration
items.description: Makes the clip record of a demonstration that was recorded: give it the media (video path or URL, poster, captions, seconds) and the recording facts; the transcript (one line per step at its time), the entries and the keyword set come from the demonstration.

items.title: Generate documentation
items.description: Generates the documentation of a book (or one demonstration, or a list of entries) from the same glossary, index and registry sources: depth light / standard / deep / extreme, format markdown / html / interactive-html-ts, interactivity none / examples / live. The files are written to the plugin's data folder and listed in a docs@1 asset with a hash of the sources it was made from.

source.description: { kind: book | demonstration | entries, id?, entries? }

items.title: One file of a generated documentation set
items.description: Serves one file (index.html, a chapter or item page, docs.css, docs.js, data/*.json) of a generated documentation set by docs id and path.

path.description: the file path inside the docs (default index.html)

ui.note: Every control of every view and dialog → the API op that does the same (build ui-api-parity-rule). What is on screen is console.values keys (value:…); edits are this plugin's commands (REST /api/plugins/glossary-index/…, MCP glossary_index_*, CLI axf glossary-index …); moving around is console actions (voice).

uiOnly.Expand all: only how the index tree is drawn; search answers the same entries
uiOnly.Collapse all: only how the index tree is drawn; search answers the same entries
uiOnly.Only undescribed: a page filter; stats counts the undescribed entries and every search row carries its generic flag
uiOnly.Show more: draws more rows; search takes a limit
uiOnly.Close details: closes the side panel; entry reads any entry

uiOnly.Revert: throws away unsaved edits in the editor; API edits (demo-change) are saved one at a time, so there is no draft to revert
uiOnly.Open video: opens the clip's video in a browser tab; demo answers its address (data.media.video)
uiOnly.Refresh: reloads the list on screen; every API read is fresh already

uiOnly.Cancel: closes the dialog without saving anything; nothing to undo over the API
uiOnly.Show more left: draws more rows of the content picker; search takes a limit
uiOnly.Refresh: reloads the list on screen; every API read is fresh already

glossary-index.book-wizard.note: its fields live in web/books.tsx and are mapped under book-builder (book-new)

glossary-index.add-to-book.note: its fields live in web/books.tsx and are mapped under book-builder (book-change add-item)
